newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks led by cement, beer demand.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks led by cement, beer demand.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed up in busy trading led by beer and cement, brokers said Monday.
Bogota's IBB price index jumped 1.89 percent to 1,225.84 on volume of 3.5 billion pesos. Medellin's IBOMED general price index finished ahead 0.96 percent to 18,521.97 on volume of 3.7 billion pesos.

Dealers said the Bogota market was driven up by a surprising 7.1 percent jump in the price of bluechip cement manufacturer Cemento Argos, a flagship of the Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate, which closed at 9,000 pesos in Bogota. It was a steady 8,500 in Medellin.
"The Argos closing price seems like a blip, because it jumped in one of the final trades of the day without any good reason," a Bogota trader said.
Brewing giant Bavaria continued its rise, closing up 4.55 percent in Bogota to 9,001.
Medellin trading was dominated by Compania Nacional de Chocolates, which held at 9,750 on volume of 415.7 million pesos. Financial giant Corfinsura closed at 2,905 on volume of 1.3 billion pesos.
